capabilities: generate a course outline for a subject
write one chapter note per outline chapter
extras: The plugin is distributed as manual installation files only (no community plugin listing mentioned). The README warns that a full subject generation can cost around US$3 with gpt-5.6-sol and advises testing one chapter first and checking provider billing dashboards. It records no telemetry and stores the API key in vault plugin data; users are warned not to publish files or screenshots containing it.
motivation: The README does not state why the author built it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate a complete structured learning course on a subject directly as vault notes.
